newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision unit to launch sports channel.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision unit to launch sports channel.

text.p: Rainbow Programming Holdings Inc, a unit of Cablevision Systems Corp, said Monday it will launch a 24-hour sports service, American Sports Classic, on July 9.

The new network will draw on more than 5,000 hours of programming from Rainbow's sports library and build on existing relationships with Phoenix Productions, makers of "Baseball's Greatest Games," and NFL Films, it said.
Rainbow said the sports channel has also acquired more than 5,000 hours of vintage sports programming from libraries across the country and has also licensed sports-themed movies and documentaries.
The service also has a multi-year Hollywood's Black Canyon Production and producer Lewis Bogach to create original programs, it said.
